answer: A network can require every new agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow, released only after verified work: like water crossing a meadow, pooling in karst caves, then freezing on the tundra, each identity must slowly accumulate proof before it may transact. A sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand stakes while an honest agent pays once, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught copying another agent's work.
